split: sort all 1000 task IDs by SHA256(ASCII ID), train first 800, use last 200 as evaluation
task_conditioned_supervised_model: sklearn decision tree classifier entropy, fixed local multiscale pixel relation features; max depth 1..6, min_samples_leaf 2
simple_no_learning_control: source-demo consistent center-color exact lookup, no learned decision tree
strong_prior_classical_control: the existing frozen ARC2 internal200 exact symbolic composition predictions from earlier verified CI: 10/200, signed artifact hash
holdout_contamination_limit: These same 200 published training tasks had earlier benchmark aggregate results exposed; they are not global firstblind or independent new task family. Present performance as repeat-cohort model-independent new method, never claim frontier or learned-exclusive primitive invention.
pass_gate: strict exact grid evidence on 200, simultaneous paired tests and full training/inference cost. No unconditional Q3/Q4/Q6 PASS.
